comment: Falsification-corpus regression anchors for the powered lens correct-loop (lens-standard-v1, Lane G harness). Pre-registered bands and tolerances live in PREREGISTRATION-lens-2026-10-06.md and are NEVER retuned post-hoc. Expected VALUES are null: they get pinned once, after the FIRST CLEAN RUN (adding values is the only permitted edit; editing a pinned value requires a logged amendment with a-priori reasoning, dated, before any re-measurement).
module_under_test: session/subagent/lane-f/lens_standard.py (Lane F; imported by path, never substituted)

golds.shuffle-s42: gen_v2.gen_shuffle(512, 42) via gen_v2.render_disks -- B3/B4/B5 only, B1/B2 reported non-gated

tolerances.B2_monotonicity: strict: |D_ab - D_ref| > |D_corr - D_ref| at every rung; D_ab drift monotonically outward in |c|

derivations.B1_B3: Half-pixel integer rasterization bounds per-droplet radius uncertainty at delta_r/r = 0.5/3 = 0.167 (r=3); pooled over N=366 with independent rounding gives sigma_chat = 0.167/sqrt(366) = 0.0087; 5-sigma = 0.044 <= 0.05. Residual sub-pixel warp contributes at most (0.5/384) x the L-convergence render-bias spread (0.099 at L=256 vs 0.012 at L=384) ~ 3e-4, negligible. B1 = 0.05 is exactly half the measured L-convergence D spread, the largest re-rasterization shift a sub-pixel-residual re-render could plausibly carry.
derivations.caveat_LF5: Gasket droplets sit on a coherent triangular lattice, so rounding bias is correlated and the sqrt(N) credit may overstate precision. If B3 fails with a coherent-sign bias, the verdict is a preregistered-amendment path (jitter-augmented gold), never a silent tolerance change.

tri.per_mode: same shape as gasket; B1/B2 reported non-gated

shuffle-s42.per_mode: same shape as gasket; B1/B2 reported non-gated

structural_asserts.LF1_fallback_verdict_if_B1_fails_only_at: correction reduces but does not eliminate the D shift

exit_codes.4: MODULE SURFACE ERROR (Lane F module or function family missing; no local substitution)

_pin_note: Pinned from the first clean run (75/75 checks PASS): gasket-v2-L384 D_ref 1.5589 n 366; worst |D_corr-D_ref| = 0.0000 across astig/spherical/trefoil on all three golds; B4 |c0| = 0.0000 byte-identical; roundtrip_recovery = 1.0000.
